55|A total of 978 patients were randomized
56|to dulaglutide 1.5 mg, dulaglutide 0.75
57|mg, exenatide, and placebo. Two pa-
58|tients assigned to exenatide did not re-
59|ceive thedrug;thus,theintention-to-treat
60|population comprised 976 patients. De-
61|mographic and baseline characteristics
62|were balanced across all arms (Table 1).
63|At randomization, 86% of patients were
64|receiving $2,500 mg/day of metformin
65|and 45 mg/day of pioglitazone, and the
66|mean doses were similar across arms. A
67|total of 77 (7.9%) patients discontinued
68|the study at 26 weeks; the distribution

72|exenatide, 24 (8.7%); and placebo, 17
73|(12.1%). The most common reasons

4|Special Treatment Considerations for Management of Patients Who Did Not Attain
5|HbA1c Target and Patients with Severe, Persistent Hyperglycemia during the Treatment
6|Period
7|
8|An additional therapeutic intervention was considered in patients with a follow-up
9|shorter than 6 months who developed persistent, severe hyperglycemia despite full compliance
10|with the assigned therapeutic regimen. Persistent, severe hyperglycemia was defined as (a)
11|average fasting blood glucose over at least a 2-week period (at least 4 values/week must be
12|available) above 270 mg/dL at any time during the first 6 weeks after randomization, or above
13|240 mg/dL over at least a 2-week period (at least 4 values/week must be available) any time
14|after the first 6 weeks postrandomization, or above 200 mg/dL at any time after the first 26
15|weeks; and (b) in the absence of any acute condition that raises blood glucose. If a patient
16|develops persistent, severe hyperglycemia, but his most recent HbA1c measurements indicate
17|a significant improvement in glycemic control (HbA1c change ≥0.3%) compared to the previous
18|value, the investigator will decide if a new intervention is warranted.
19|
20|Patients with persistent postrandomization HbA1c values ≥8% (64 mmol/mol) (on 2 or
21|more occasions at least 12 weeks apart) during the second 26 weeks of the treatment period
22|should be considered for further therapeutic intervention.
23|
24|Intervention was based on standards of care (17, 18), and was determined by the
25|investigator, but the patients should have continued administering their allocated LY2189265
26|dose. The use of other incretin mimetics (for example, liraglutide or exenatide) was not
27|permitted (other than study drug or those already randomized to exenatide).

Placebo once weekly with metformin and pioglitazone

target.intended_analysis_population: All randomized participants in the comparison groups

reported.analysis_population: Intent-to-treat population of randomized patients who received at least one dose (976 of 978 randomized); efficacy data after rescue medication were excluded. ANCOVA with LOCF for missing data.

result.relation_rationale: The requested primary result is change in HbA1c from baseline at 26 weeks comparing randomized dulaglutide 1.5 mg with placebo. Outcome, measurement, time and comparison match; the figure reports ANCOVA LOCF values and methods define the efficacy analysis population.
